multiplication: Combining equal groups; not adding the two factors.
array: Objects arranged in equal rows and columns.
mastery: Practice indicator: three consecutive correct unassisted first answers, not an attainment assessment.
times table: Facts for multiplication by a specified number.
equal groups: Each group has the same number of objects.
spark: A story reward; never a payment unit.
parent gate: Access barrier; not verifiable parental consent.
